s: Hello and welcome to Word Kitchen!
Today we learn words about our body.
Our body is with us every day!
And moving our body is good for our health.
A healthy body is a happy body.
Let us start at the top.
Your head is the top part of your body.
And on your head, you have hair.
My hair is long and brown.
I wash my hair every morning.
My hair is short and black.
Touch your hair with your hand.
Now, on your face you have two eyes.
Your eye is the part you see with.
Can you see me with your eyes closed?
When I close my eyes, I cannot see.
Now, between your eyes, what do you have?
Your nose is the part you smell with.
Smell this flower with your nose.
And under your nose, you have your mouth.
Your mouth is the part you eat with.
You also speak with your mouth.
Say hello with your mouth, Lena!
Now let us move down to your arm.
Your arm is the long part from your shoulder to your hand.
And at the end of your arm, you have your hand.
Your leg is the long part from your hip to your foot.
And at the end of your leg, you have your foot.
Your back is the part behind your body.
Sit up straight, and your back will be happy.
A strong back is good for your health.
Touch your hair, your eye, your nose, and your mouth.
Raise your arm and wave your hand!
Stand on one leg and lift your foot!
Let us do it one more time, fast!
One head, two hands, two feet!
Two eyes, one nose, one mouth!
Two arms, two legs, one back!
When your back hurts, sit up straight.
And wash your hands before you eat with your mouth.
That is good for your health.
And brush your hair, and wash your foot and your leg after sport.
A clean body is a healthy body.
What color is your eye, Lena?
And my nose is small, but my mouth is big!
Can you lift your hand high?
And my leg is strong too.
I can lift my foot high!
Now touch your back with your hand.
Remember, take care of your body every day.
Drink water, move your body, and stay healthy.
That is our show for today.
Join us tomorrow for more words.
